basics.description:
**Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/Lookout/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. The [Lookout](https://lookout.com) solution provides the capability to ingest [Lookout events](https://www.lookout.com/products/mobile-endpoint-security) into Microsoft Sentinel through the Mobile Risk API. It can get events which helps to examine potential security risks and more. Refer to [API documentation](https://www.lookout.com/products/mobile-endpoint-security) for more information. **Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:** This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs: a. [Azure Monitor HTTP Data Collector API](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/data-collector-api) b. [Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Platform](https://aka.ms/Sentinel-CCP_Platform)

NOTE: Microsoft recommends installation of "LookoutStreaming_Definition" (via Codeless Connector Framework). This connector is build on the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF), which uses the Log Ingestion API, which replaces ingestion via the deprecated HTTP Data Collector API. CCF-based data connectors also support Data Collection Rules (DCRs) offering transformations and enrichment.

Important: While the updated connector(s) can coexist with their legacy versions, running them together will result in duplicated data ingestion. You can disable the older versions of these connectors to avoid duplication of data.

**Data Connectors:** 2, **Parsers:** 1, **Workbooks:** 5, **Analytic Rules:** 6, **Hunting Queries:** 1, **Notebooks:** 4, **Playbooks:** 3 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This Solution installs the data connector for Lookout. You can get Lookout custom log data in your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. After installing the solution, configure and enable this data connector by following guidance in Manage solution view.

This Solution installs the data connector for Lookout Mobile Threat Detection Connector (via Codeless Connector Framework). You can get Lookout Mobile Threat Detection Connector (via Codeless Connector Framework) data in your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. After installing the solution, configure and enable this data connector by following guidance in Manage solution view.

options.text: This solution installs workbook(s) to help you gain insights into the telemetry collected in Microsoft Sentinel. After installing the solution, start using the workbook in Manage solution view.
Sets the time name for analysis

This workbook leverages the enhanced Lookout Mobile Risk API v2 data with comprehensive field extraction and advanced threat intelligence. It depends on the LookoutEvents parser deployed with the Microsoft Sentinel Solution.
Real-time mobile threat investigation and incident response
Real-time mobile threat detection and device security monitoring
Comprehensive mobile threat intelligence, device investigation, and security posture monitoring
This solution installs the following analytic rule templates. After installing the solution, create and enable analytic rules in Manage solution view.
Created to detect new Threat events from the data which is recently synced by Lookout Solution.

elements.name: analytic2
elements.label: Lookout - High Severity Mobile Threats Detected (v2)

options.text: Detects open high severity mobile threats reported by the Lookout Mobile Risk API v2, including malicious applications, OS and configuration risks, network threats and web content threats. Each threat is alerted once per ingestion window with the affected device, user, file hash and URL mapped as entities.

elements.name: analytic3
elements.label: Lookout - Device Compliance and Security Status Changes (v2)

options.text: Detects mobile devices moving into a degraded security state reported by the Lookout Mobile Risk API v2: high-severity threats present, Lookout protection disconnected, or device deactivated. A device alerts when its posture changes compared with its previous state in the last 7 days, not on every check-in. Platform, OS version, patch level and MDM context are included.

elements.name: analytic4
elements.label: Lookout - Critical Smishing and Phishing Alerts (v2)

options.text: Detects new smishing (SMS phishing) alerts from Lookout Mobile Risk API v2, including fraud detections, embedded phishing URLs and suspicious-intent messages. Fraud and URL detections are raised as High severity, suspicious detections as Medium. The impersonated employee, sender and phishing URL are included when Lookout reports them.

elements.name: analytic5
elements.label: Lookout - Critical Audit and Policy Changes (v2)

options.text: Detects administrative changes in the Lookout console reported by the Lookout Mobile Risk API v2 audit feed: changes to admin accounts, tenancy and enterprise settings, classification, allowlist and denylist policies, smishing and vishing settings, device groups, URL classifications, data exports and admin-initiated device deletions. Routine admin logins and logouts and system-initiated changes are excluded. Changes are grouped into one alert per admin and audit type per run, with the change count, affected targets and attribute changes included.

elements.name: analytic6
elements.label: Lookout - Mobile Threat Defense connector not ingesting data (v2)

options.text:
Detects when the Lookout Mobile Threat Detection CCF connector has not ingested any events into LookoutMtdV2_CL for 24 hours or more.
The Lookout Mobile Risk API only serves the last 10 days of events, so an unnoticed outage permanently loses data. Common causes are an expired or revoked API key, a connector instance created by an older solution version (disconnect and reconnect the connector to apply the current configuration), or Lookout API errors visible in the SentinelHealth table.
This solution installs the following hunting queries. After installing the solution, run these hunting queries to hunt for threats in Manage solution view.

elements.name: huntingquery1
elements.label: Lookout Advanced Threat Hunting - Multi-Vector Attacks

options.text: Identifies devices hit through two or more attack vectors (distinct medium/high threat types and smishing) within the hunting window, indicating a coordinated or multi-stage mobile attack This hunting query depends on LookoutStreaming_Definition data connector (LookoutMtdV2_CL Parser or Table)

This solution installs the Playbook templates to help implement your Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) operations. After installing the solution, these will be deployed under Playbook Templates in the Automation blade in Microsoft Sentinel. They can be configured and managed from the Manage solution view in Content Hub.
